text:
Lina Chen: Heads-up — planning MIG-987 (add search_score index + backfill) tomorrow 03:00 UTC during the quiet window.
Lina Chen: Deploybot scheduled: https://deploybot/release/987 (canary -> main at 03:05).
Lina Chen: Need a clear rollback plan, pin for service v2.4.1, and confirmation that the backfill will be rate-capped.
Raj Patel: Ack. Can you paste estimated backfill rows and expected QPS impact?
Lina Chen: Backfill ~18M rows, we'll run in chunks of 50k rows, estimated 12-14h if unthrottled. With rate cap and smallbatch it should finish in ~6-8h.
Samir Gupta: Recommend preflight: run the backfill dry on staging with identical chunk size + db-tuner flags. Also add a soft-failpoint to stop after N chunks.
Maya Ortiz: +1 on soft-failpoint. Also we should pin the API-mux to v2.4.1 for the window to avoid schema mismatch. Do we have a rollout flag?
Kevin O'Neill: I'll pin the canary routing to v2.4.1 during the window and unpin after backfill finishes. Ops runbook: https://wiki/internal/mig-987-runbook
deploybot: Deploy scheduled by Lina Chen for 2026-04-12 03:05 UTC. Canary deploy starts now -> monitors latency and error-rate for 10m.
Raj Patel: If the backfill causes high lock contention, what's the immediate escape hatch?
Samir Gupta: Escape hatch: 1) Pause backfill job queue (jobctl pause mig-987-backfill) 2) Revert index creation if necessary (alter table drop index if created but unused) 3) Fallback to read-only mode for write-heavy endpoints for 15m while we probe.
Lina Chen: Add rollback SQL here:
```sql
-- rollback: drop added index and resume old plan
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_search_score;
-- if partial state exists, mark rows for retry
UPDATE migrations_meta SET state='paused' WHERE migration='MIG-987';
```
Maya Ortiz: For service pinning, I'll add a feature flag gate: feature.search_index_mig987 = off by default. Enable only after canary is green.
Kevin O'Neill: Ops checklist for day-of:
- 02:30 UTC: run healthcheck-scan across replicas
- 02:40 UTC: warm up backfill workers
- 03:00 UTC: deploybot canary -> verify no error-rate spike
- 03:15 UTC: start index create on writer (concurrently)
- 03:30 UTC: start backfill queue with ratecap=0.2 (20% CPU budget)
- Holdpoint at 04:30 UTC to assess.
Lina Chen: Someone from SRE on call at holdpoint? @Kevin O'Neill please confirm.
Kevin O'Neill: I'll be on-call for 02:30-05:00 UTC. Opsbot will post reminders.
opsbot: Reminder set — holdpoint check at 04:30 UTC for thread 4460012345.
Raj Patel: If we see a 2xx->5xx increase >1% sustained for 5m, do immediate pause and rollback. I'll prepare the quick rollback script and attach it to the runbook.
Samir Gupta: Also add a preflight DB check to ensure no long-running tx >2m before index create. Script snippet:
```bash
pg_long_tx_check || exit 1
deploy_index --concurrent
```
Maya Ortiz: Release notes line for this change (short): "Add search_score index and background backfill to improve search relevance; will be deployed during quiet window. Rollback available if contention observed."
Lina Chen: +1. I'll merge the release notes into the changelog and tag the release.
Kevin O'Neill: One more: quota alert for backfill jobs - if we use >30% write IOPS for 10m, auto-throttle to 10%. That is configured in jobctl policy 'mig-987-throttle'.
Lina Chen: Perfect. Last ask — can someone own manual rollback in case the automated scripts fail?
Raj Patel: I'll own manual rollback and be at the holdpoint. Call me on slack +pager if needed.
Maya Ortiz: I'll coordinate the feature flag un/pinning post-verification.
Samir Gupta: I will watch DB metrics and be ready to run the dump of stalled rows if we detect deadlocks.
Lina Chen: Thanks all — plan looks good. I'll post the final ops link and checklist 1h before window. :thumbsup:
